session: Session 5: Failure Injection, Concurrency & Safe Recovery

paper_jam_and_out_of_paper.injection: Virtual spooler emits status BLOCKED / JAM
paper_jam_and_out_of_paper.behavior: Job quarantined to ADMIN_ACTION_REQUIRED; printer marked degraded/blocked; queue remains unblocked for other active printers

spooler_clear_command_failure.injection: CLEAR_SPOOLER command fails or remains IN_PROGRESS
spooler_clear_command_failure.behavior: Printer is strictly gated in SQL claim query via spooler_clear_in_progress=1; zero jobs dispatched until cleared

agent_crash_during_printing.injection: Agent process terminates abruptly while order is in PRINTING; clock advanced past 300,000ms lease
agent_crash_during_printing.behavior: Claim lease expires safely in D1; lease is reclaimed on next pulse without duplicate spool submission

uncertain_spool_completion.injection: Network drop or agent crash between spool submission and complete acknowledgement
uncertain_spool_completion.behavior: State safely flagged for recovery verification; zero speculative reprints without verification

usb_disconnect_offline_recovery.injection: Printer status changed to OFFLINE during queue cycle
usb_disconnect_offline_recovery.behavior: Queue gracefully pauses claims for this printer; candidate orders wait in QUEUED or fallback if enabled

invariant_enforced: Fail-closed safety under 100% of injected failure conditions; zero duplicate prints
